prompt: A slow continuous 360 degree orbit around a circular ancient stone chamber, the camera gliding at a steady constant speed in one unbroken circle and never reversing. A carved granite brazier at the exact centre of the frame burns with a steady flame, orange firelight rippling across wet flagstones, rivulets of water running down damp walls, a stalactite dripping into a still black pool and sending out one continuous expanding ring of ripples. Fine dust and glowing embers rise continuously in the warm air and fade out at the top of the frame, and a carved rune circle in the floor around the brazier glows faintly and pulses in a slow regular rhythm. Every element turns in perfect lockstep with the camera so the last image is identical to the first image, the whole motion repeating endlessly with no change and no progression. No characters and no creature move through the chamber. One continuous unbroken take with no cuts.
